# OpenMesh

> Open-source, end-to-end encrypted mesh messaging over LoRa — text, images, voice notes and
> position sharing without accounts, cell towers or cloud services. Includes a Rust protocol core,
> a local bridge daemon with WebSocket/REST/MCP APIs, a React web/PWA client, LoRa firmware, a
> self-hosted backbone mode for linking distant meshes, and an AI-native agent surface.

OpenMesh v0.7.0. AI-assisted, human-directed and human-QA'd; see AI-POLICY.md. Normative contracts live in `docs/architecture/`; user-facing help topics live in
`content/help/` and are served by the bridge and web UI. Repository: https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/README.md): project overview, feature status, quick start, hardware.
- [Quick start: zero to secure mesh in 10 minutes](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): beginner path with demo and real-radio options.
- [Install guide](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): one-line installer, manual install, services, update/uninstall, troubleshooting.
- [Glossary](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/glossary.md): every protocol and UX term in one place.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/guides/faq.md): product, identity, mesh-behaviour and agent questions.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for coding agents working on this repository.
- [AI policy](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/AI-POLICY.md): strict rules for AI-assisted contributions, disclosure, review, licensing and security. Contributions are closed for now.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution status (closed) and the rules that will apply when they open.

## Architecture (normative)

- [ARCHITECTURE](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md): components, boundaries, key decisions.
- [PROTOCOL (OMP/1)](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/architecture/PROTOCOL.md): wire format, headers, crypto, resources, store-and-forward, constants.
- [WEBSOCKET-API](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/architecture/WEBSOCKET-API.md): bridge WebSocket events/commands and REST surface.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 (REST)](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/api/openapi.json): machine-readable bridge REST contract.
- [BACKBONE (OBB/1)](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/architecture/BACKBONE.md): authenticated TCP relay, config, API, security model.
- [AI-NATIVE](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/architecture/AI-NATIVE.md): MCP server, tool catalog, activity log, prompt pack, OpenAPI requirements.
- [UX & help system](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/design/ux-help-system.md): beginner/advanced modes, help surfaces, setup presets.
- [COMPANION-API](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/architecture/COMPANION-API.md): BLE/USB companion protocol for mobile firmware links.
- [ROADMAP](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): milestones and scope; v0.5.0 is the legal-maxima + emergency-override release.

## Guides

- [Backbone deployment & operations](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/operations/backbone-deployment.md): sizing, monitoring, backups, TLS/VPN, multi-region, incidents.
- [Advanced cookbook](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/guides/advanced-cookbook.md): radio tuning, WireGuard backbone, API scripting, MCP automations, backups/migration.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/guides/troubleshooting.md): symptom → check → fix, logs, diagnostic commands.
- [Research notes](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/research/): comparative and technical background (Meshtastic/MeshCore, Reticulum/LXMF, LoRa capacity, NomadNet, AI workflows).

## Agents and automation

- [MCP server reference](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/agents/mcp.md): install/config for Claude Desktop/Code, Cursor, DSH and generic clients; env vars; 27-tool catalog; resources/prompts; read-only mode; safety; troubleshooting.
- [Prompt pack](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/docs/agents/prompts.md): copy-paste prompts for troubleshooting, family setup, backup/migration, VPS backbone, API integration, sensor/radio tweaks, daily operations.
- [Help topic: Use your AI agent](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/content/help/agents.md): beginner-friendly agent usage.
- [Help corpus index](https://github.com/martintondel02/openmesh/blob/main/content/help/index.json): machine-readable topic metadata (17 topics; beginner/advanced/both).

## Machine-readable surfaces

- Bridge: `http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/health` (public), `/api/openapi.json` (full REST), `/api/help` + `/api/help/{slug}` (help corpus), `/api/ws` (WebSocket), `/api/events` (SSE).
- MCP: `openmesh-bridge mcp` (stdio JSON-RPC; tools `openmesh_health`, `openmesh_status`, `openmesh_nodes`, `openmesh_messages`, `openmesh_channels`, `openmesh_contacts`, `openmesh_backbone_status`, `openmesh_setup_state`, `openmesh_activity`, `openmesh_help`, writes incl. `openmesh_send_message`, `openmesh_setup_quick`; read-only mode via `OPENMESH_MCP_READ_ONLY=1`).
- Help index: `content/help/index.json`; OpenAPI document also served at `/api/openapi.json`.
- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later. See `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`.
